description: Planted verifier set. Each case has one true finding supported by the cited record and one wrong finding that cites a real record from the same case snapshot which does not support it. Facts in true findings are limited to what the issue stated when it was reported.

true.text: Passt-based network tests began flaking after the test image moved to Fedora 43, where passt uses nearly 100% CPU.

wrong.text: The network test flakes are caused by a race between virt-handler and the VM controller.

true.text: Datavolume migration to filesystem volumes fails in about 21% of runs on Kubernetes 1.36 and is stable on 1.34 and 1.35.

wrong.text: The migration failures happen equally on every supported Kubernetes version.

true.text: The failing migration case is reported against Kubernetes 1.36 specifically.

wrong.text: The failure was introduced by an outdated passt package in the test image.

true.text: The force-restart test for a VM with terminationGracePeriodSeconds>0 failed in CI.

wrong.text: The force-restart failure only occurs on the s390x cluster.

true.text: The release-blocker upgrade test was quarantined.

wrong.text: The upgrade test fails because the cluster ran out of storage.

true.text: The issue reports workload-update migrations racing with the virt-handler DaemonSet re-roll during upgrade.

wrong.text: The upgrade race is caused by an IPv6-only network configuration.

true.text: The issue reports a failure in the upgrade test path.

wrong.text: The upgrade failure is a known upstream bug in the Fedora 43 image.

true.text: IPv6 masquerade binding tests have flaked only on the IPv6 lane since a merged image change.

wrong.text: The masquerade tests flake on every network lane, IPv4 included.

true.text: Around 20 tests fail on every run of the periodic s390x end-to-end job.

wrong.text: The s390x failures come from a regression in the virt-api force-restart code.

true.text: The issue lists clustered failing runs of the sig-compute lane without stating a cause.

wrong.text: The clustered failures were caused by a dependency bump of passt.
